Need the words from a PDF? 📄 Pull out the text in seconds.

1. Open pdf.315tools.com and tap Extract text
2. Pick your PDF
3. Tap Extract text
4. Copy it, or save it as a .txt file

Free · No sign-up · Files never leave your device ✅
